description: NaLuS₂ is Caswellsilverite structured and crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3m space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded to six equivalent S²⁻ atoms to form NaS₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent LuS₆ octahedra, edges with six equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent LuS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 6°. All Na-S bond lengths are 2.89 Å. Lu³⁺ is bonded to six equivalent S²⁻ atoms to form LuS₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, edges with six equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent LuS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 6°. All Lu-S bond lengths are 2.68 Å. S²⁻ is bonded to three equivalent Na¹⁺ and three equivalent Lu³⁺ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SNa₃Lu₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted.
